Author: penguin4glte
Name: Auto Retainer Sell List
Description: Configure a list of items to maintain on sale at (lowest market price - 1 gil)
Changelog: Fixed an issue where a sale could be canceled with "No market board listings found" even though the item had listings. The game only fills in its listing data after all batches have arrived, and when the server paused between batches the plugin read the data too early. The plugin now waits until the game data is filled in, and falls back to the listings received via Dalamud's event if it never arrives. Also updated ECommons for compatibility with Dalamud 15.0.4.0.
